title: 10 Late-Night Runs That Explain Lewis & Clark College
description: Ten under-21-safe food and drink destinations with officially documented hours of 11 p.m. or later, spanning Southwest Portland and the wider metro area.

cards.title: Barbur’s After-Midnight Drive-Through
cards.subtitle: A Southwest Portland stop serving until 4 or 5 a.m.
cards.notes: Check the drive-through schedule before leaving campus; the dining room closes well before the overnight service ends.
cards.short_summary: The board’s closest verified deep-night option follows Barbur Boulevard south of campus.
cards.evidence_claim: Taco Bell’s official location page lists this Portland address and drive-through hours until 4 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 5 a.m. Friday–Saturday.
cards.source_title: Taco Bell in Portland, OR — 7710 SW Barbur Blvd
cards.access_notes: Drive-through: 9 a.m.–4 a.m. Sunday–Thursday and 9 a.m.–5 a.m. Friday–Saturday; dine-in closes earlier. Verify before departure.

cards.title: A Friday-Night Pie-House Run
cards.subtitle: A Tigard diner with 11 p.m. weekend closing
cards.notes: Save this run for Friday or Saturday, when the official schedule adds an hour beyond the restaurant’s weekday close.
cards.short_summary: A Southwest metro diner extends its schedule specifically on Friday and Saturday nights.
cards.evidence_claim: Banning’s official site lists its Tigard location as open until 11 p.m. Friday and Saturday and until 10 p.m. on other days.
cards.access_notes: Open 7 a.m.–11 p.m. Friday–Saturday; closes at 10 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday. Verify current hours before traveling.

cards.title: Midnight Slices on Southwest Oak
cards.subtitle: Downtown pizza served until midnight every day
cards.notes: Use the downtown address when planning the run; the official locations page distinguishes it from other Sizzle Pie sites.
cards.short_summary: A daily midnight closing makes this downtown pizzeria usable beyond weekend-only late-night windows.
cards.evidence_claim: Sizzle Pie’s official locations page lists its Downtown restaurant at 949 SW Oak Street and states that it operates from 11 a.m. to midnight every day.
cards.access_notes: Open 11 a.m.–midnight daily according to the official locations page. Confirm hours before leaving campus.

cards.title: An Eleven O’Clock Downtown Dinner
cards.subtitle: Vietnamese food near the South Waterfront approach
cards.notes: Arrive before the 11 p.m. dinner close and keep the full party together; the restaurant says seating is first-come, first-served.
cards.short_summary: This downtown kitchen provides a late dinner window without requiring entry to a 21-plus venue.
cards.evidence_claim: Lúc Lắc’s official website lists dinner every day from 4 to 11 p.m. and identifies nonalcoholic drinks alongside its food menu.
cards.access_notes: Dinner is served daily from 4–11 p.m.; the patio also closes at 11 p.m. The restaurant is walk-in and does not accept reservations.

cards.title: Coffee Until Midnight on Main Street
cards.subtitle: A Southwest metro café open late seven days a week
cards.notes: Choose the Downtown Tigard café, not the adjacent bakery or roastery; each AVA operation has a different schedule.
cards.short_summary: This Main Street café supplies a midnight endpoint south of campus throughout the week.
cards.evidence_claim: AVA Roasteria’s official locations page lists its Downtown Tigard café at 12539–12543 SW Main Street as open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 a.m.–midnight. The neighboring AVA bakery and roastery keep different hours, so confirm the café address.

cards.title: A Midnight Café Run to Beaverton
cards.subtitle: Coffee and café drinks west of Portland until midnight
cards.notes: Plan this as a longer westside trip and use the SW Hall Boulevard address; another nearby AVA facility is listed as closed.
cards.short_summary: A second all-ages midnight café extends the board into downtown Beaverton.
cards.evidence_claim: AVA Roasteria’s official locations page lists its Downtown Beaverton café at 4655 SW Hall Boulevard as open daily from 6 a.m. to midnight.
cards.access_notes: Open daily from 6 a.m.–midnight. Do not confuse it with the nearby Roastery by AVA Beaverton, which the page marks temporarily closed.

cards.entity_name: Dutch Bros Coffee — 8169 NE Air Cargo Road
cards.title: The Around-the-Clock Coffee Window
cards.subtitle: A 24-hour drive-through near Portland International Airport
cards.notes: Treat this as an airport-area vehicle run: overnight service uses the stand, while the official page limits lobby hours to daytime.
cards.short_summary: Portland’s airport district supplies the board’s officially verified 24-hour coffee stop.
cards.evidence_claim: Dutch Bros’ official page identifies the NE Air Cargo Road location and lists store hours from 12 a.m. to 11:59 p.m. every day.
cards.source_title: Dutch Bros in Portland, OR — 8169 NE Air Cargo Rd.
cards.access_notes: Store service is listed for 12 a.m.–11:59 p.m. daily; lobby hours are only 5 a.m.–7 p.m. Use the drive-through overnight.

cards.title: Donuts at Any Hour on NE 102nd
cards.subtitle: One of the bakery’s officially listed 24-hour shops
cards.notes: Use the NE 102nd Avenue address for this run and check directly before a cross-city trip in case the published schedule changes.
cards.short_summary: A named Portland doughnut shop offers a documented all-night counter east of the river.
cards.evidence_claim: Heavenly Donuts’ official locations page lists its shop at 504 NE 102nd Avenue and states that all of its locations are open 24 hours.
cards.access_notes: The official business page states that all locations are open 24 hours. Verify directly before making the longer trip from campus.

cards.entity_name: Baby Doll Pizza — SE Stark Street
cards.title: Weekend Midnight Pizza on Stark
cards.subtitle: An all-ages pizzeria with later Friday and Saturday hours
cards.notes: Select the original SE Stark Street shop and go on Friday or Saturday for midnight service; the northeast outlet closes earlier.
cards.short_summary: The original Baby Doll location adds a weekend-only midnight pizza option in inner Southeast Portland.
cards.evidence_claim: Baby Doll Pizza’s official website lists the original shop at 2835 SE Stark Street and hours until midnight Friday and Saturday.
cards.access_notes: SE Stark location: 11 a.m.–midnight Friday–Saturday and 11 a.m.–11 p.m. Monday–Thursday and Sunday. Confirm before traveling.

cards.title: A 24-Hour West Burnside Standby
cards.subtitle: Round-the-clock lobby and drive-through service downtown
cards.notes: Use the exact West Burnside location page when checking service; McDonald’s notes that hours are determined restaurant by restaurant.
cards.short_summary: A central Portland chain location provides documented 24-hour indoor and drive-through access.
cards.evidence_claim: McDonald’s official page for 1831 W Burnside lists both restaurant-and-lobby and drive-through service as open 24 hours every day.
cards.source_title: McDonald’s at 1831 W Burnside, Portland, OR
cards.access_notes: Restaurant, lobby, and drive-through are listed as open 24 hours Monday–Sunday. Recheck the location page because local hours can change.
